description: Build the Notifee presentation + delivery layer in the mobile app: channels, a single displayPush() presenter (right-side colour largeIcon always + BIGPICTURE banner only when data.image is set), FCM token via @react-native-firebase/messaging, foreground delivery via messaging().onMessage, background/killed delivery via setBackgroundMessageHandler registered at the native entry, tap routing through the existing legacyToRoute path, and REMOVAL of the expo-notifications display path so each push is drawn exactly ONCE. This is the MOBILE half of the plan.md D4 contract and the duplicate-display mechanism (D3). Depends on FEAT-001 (deps/plugins) and FEAT-002 (final flat data keys).
steps: In mobile/src/push.ts: replace the expo-notifications ensureChannels() with a Notifee version using notifee.createChannel for 'default' (importance AndroidImportance.HIGH, sound 'default', vibration [0,250,150,250], lights true/#FF7A00) and 'orders' (importance AndroidImportance.HIGH, sound 'default', vibration [0,500,250,500,250,500], lights true/#FF7A00, visibility public). Keep the function name ensureChannels and the Platform.OS !== 'android' early return.

Add displayPush(data: PushData) that calls notifee.displayNotification({ id: data.orderId || undefined, title: data.title || '', body: data.body || '', data, android: { channelId: data.channelId || 'default', smallIcon: <exact small-icon drawable name>, color: '#FF7A00', largeIcon: <bundled @drawable/notification_large_icon via require('../assets/images/notification-large-icon.png') OR data.largeIcon URL>, pressAction: { id: 'default' }, ...(data.image ? { style: { type: AndroidStyle.BIGPICTURE, picture: data.image } } : {}) } }). Confirm the exact small-icon drawable name by inspecting mobile/android/app/src/main/res/drawable* after a prebuild, or reuse the resource the expo-notifications plugin registers (commonly 'notification_icon' / 'ic_notification'); use the verbatim name and record it in findings.
Update PushData type to include title?, body?, channelId?, image?, sound? (the new flat keys from FEAT-002) alongside the existing type/orderId/link/customerName/total/city/largeIcon.

Rewrite registerForPush(): keep HAS_PUSH/Device.isDevice/getAccessToken guards and expo-notifications permission request (Notifications.requestPermissionsAsync) OR notifee.requestPermission; then get the token via messaging().getToken(); POST { token, platform } to '/push/register'; store in AsyncStorage. Replace listenTokenRotation to use messaging().onTokenRefresh(() => registerForPush()).

Replace listenForeground with a function that subscribes messaging().onMessage(async (remoteMessage) => { await ensureChannels(); await displayPush(remoteMessage.data as PushData); }) and returns the unsubscribe. Keep the side-effect hook: expose the parsed data/title to the caller OR invoke the same onData callback _layout uses for query invalidation + toast.

Replace listenNotificationTaps with Notifee tap handling: notifee.onForegroundEvent((event) => { if (event.type === EventType.PRESS && event.detail.notification?.data?.link) onLink(link, data) }) plus notifee.getInitialNotification() for cold-start taps. Route data.link through the SAME onLink callback the app already passes.
Switch localOrderAlert to notifee.displayNotification on the 'orders' channel with pressAction/link, so there is a single notification source.

REMOVE Notifications.setNotificationHandler(...) and the expo addNotificationReceivedListener display path entirely (duplicate-display prevention D3b). Add a top-of-file comment documenting D3: server is data-only (no OS auto-draw), foreground via onMessage->Notifee only, background/killed via setBackgroundMessageHandler->Notifee only, so exactly one draw per message.

Create the native entry mobile/index.js that, at module top-level BEFORE React renders, registers messaging().setBackgroundMessageHandler(async (remoteMessage) => { await ensureChannels(); await displayPush(remoteMessage.data as PushData); }) and notifee.onBackgroundEvent(async (event) => { if (event.type === EventType.PRESS) { /* deep link handled on next app open via getInitialNotification */ } }); then require('expo-router/entry'). Update mobile/package.json "main" from 'expo-router/entry' to './index.js'. (If an index entry already exists, add the handler there instead.)

In mobile/app/_layout.tsx: replace the listenForeground/listenNotificationTaps imports and useEffects with the new Notifee foreground + tap subscriptions, preserving navigateToLink/legacyToRoute routing, the pendingLink cold-start flush, and the query-invalidation + toast side effects on type 'new_order'/'order_reminder'/'order_status'. Keep ensureChannels() on mount and registerForPush() on login/role change.
acceptance_criteria: mobile/src/push.ts uses notifee for channels + display; no Notifications.setNotificationHandler and no expo addNotificationReceivedListener display path remain.
displayPush sets android.largeIcon always and android.style BIGPICTURE only when data.image is present; smallIcon + color '#FF7A00' set; channelId honoured.
Token is obtained from messaging().getToken() and registered to '/push/register'; token rotation via onTokenRefresh.
A native entry (mobile/index.js or equivalent) registers setBackgroundMessageHandler at top level and package.json main points at it; expo-router still boots.
Tap on a notification routes data.link through legacyToRoute exactly as before (foreground, warm, and cold start).
`npm run typecheck` has no new errors beyond usesCleartextTraffic; `npm test` passes; `npx expo config --json` resolves with versionCode 24 and notifee + firebase plugins.

findings:
Implemented the Notifee presentation + delivery layer in mobile/src/push.ts and the native entry mobile/index.js.

DUPLICATE-DISPLAY PREVENTION (D3), also documented in a top-of-file comment in src/push.ts and in index.js: Each push is drawn EXACTLY ONCE by Notifee on every lifecycle. (1) The server (FEAT-002) sends DATA-ONLY FCM messages (no `notification` block), so FCM/Android never auto-draws a tray notification. (2) Foreground: messaging().onMessage -> ensureChannels() + displayPush() (one draw). (3) Background/killed: messaging().setBackgroundMessageHandler at the native top-level entry (mobile/index.js, registered BEFORE expo-router boots) -> ensureChannels() + displayPush() (one draw). (4) The old expo-notifications display path was REMOVED: Notifications.setNotificationHandler and addNotificationReceivedListener are gone. expo-notifications is now used ONLY for the Android POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission prompt/status via getPushPermission()/requestPermissionsAsync() (kept because app/(tabs)/profile.tsx and app/admin/orders.tsx consume Notifications.PermissionStatus). Net: data-only server + single Notifee presenter per lifecycle = one notification.

SMALL-ICON RESOURCE NAME (confirmed verbatim): `notification_icon` i.e. @drawable/notification_icon. Confirmed from node_modules/expo-notifications/plugin/build/withNotificationsAndroid.js where NOTIFICATION_ICON = 'notification_icon' and NOTIFICATION_ICON_RESOURCE = `@drawable/${NOTIFICATION_ICON}` is registered as both the FCM and local default notification icon. Used as android.smallIcon = 'notification_icon' in displayPush(). android.color = '#FF7A00'. android.largeIcon = data.largeIcon (server URL) when present else the bundled require('../assets/images/notification-large-icon.png'); set ALWAYS. android.style = BIGPICTURE only when data.image is set.

DATA CONTRACT: PushData extended with the FEAT-002 flat keys title, body, channelId, image, sound (alongside existing type/orderId/link/customerName/total/city/largeIcon). displayPush reads these verbatim: title/body/channelId/image/largeIcon.

CHANNELS: ensureChannels() now uses notifee.createChannel for 'default' (AndroidImportance.HIGH, sound default, vibration [0,250,150,250], lights #FF7A00) and 'orders' (AndroidImportance.HIGH, sound default, vibration [0,500,250,500,250,500], lights #FF7A00, visibility PUBLIC). Platform.OS !== 'android' early return kept. NOTE: the previous expo channel used importance MAX for 'orders'; Notifee's AndroidImportance has no MAX (HIGH is the top heads-up importance), and the plan explicitly specified AndroidImportance.HIGH for both channels, so HIGH is used per plan — no user-visible behaviour change requiring escalation.

TOKEN: registerForPush() now gets the token via messaging().getToken() (was Notifications.getDevicePushTokenAsync) and POSTs { token, platform } to '/push/register'; HAS_PUSH/Device.isDevice/getAccessToken guards + permission request + AsyncStorage persistence unchanged. listenTokenRotation() now uses messaging().onTokenRefresh(() => registerForPush()).

TAP ROUTING: listenNotificationTaps() uses notifee.onForegroundEvent (EventType.PRESS -> onLink(data.link)) plus notifee.getInitialNotification() for cold start; routes data.link through the SAME onLink callback _layout.tsx passes (navigateToLink -> legacyToRoute). listenForeground/listenNotificationTaps/listenTokenRotation keep their original names + return-unsubscribe signatures, so app/_layout.tsx needed no edits and its navigateToLink/legacyToRoute routing, pendingLink cold-start flush, and query-invalidation + toast side effects on new_order/order_reminder/order_status are all preserved.

localOrderAlert(title, body, orderId) kept its signature but now calls displayPush() on channel 'orders' with link /admin/orders?view=<id> (single Notifee source).

NATIVE ENTRY: mobile/index.js registers setBackgroundMessageHandler + notifee.onBackgroundEvent at top level then require('expo-router/entry'); mobile/package.json "main" changed from 'expo-router/entry' to './index.js'.

VERIFICATION (all from mobile dir): `npm run typecheck` -> exit 0, ZERO errors (the usesCleartextTraffic field was already removed from app.config.ts in SDK 54 so even that known error does not appear). `npm test` -> 39/39 pass. `npx expo config --json` -> android.versionCode = 24; plugins include @react-native-firebase/app and expo-notifications; Notifee has no config plugin for 9.1.8 and works via RN autolinking (per app.config.ts comment), so it is a dependency only. A real tray look still needs a signed AAB device build at versionCode 24 (not built here).
